name: Kuro
source:
"[i]Don't worry. I won't ever, ever, leave you alone.[/i]"

The protagonist’s partner... or perhaps it’d be more accurate to say she’s his family.

A [b]special black cat[/b] who, despite her clumsy speech, can speak human language.
She took on human form to become a friend to the lonely Taiga.
Despite originally being a black cat, in human form, her [b]hair is white[/b]. How strange!

The two have been together since childhood,
always by each other's side. Her body hasn't grown alongside Taiga's,
remaining small no matter how much time passes.

She used to be bigger than Taiga,
so she pouts about how it’s not fair.

She is extremely shy by nature and can't make eye contact
or hold a proper conversation with anyone other than Taiga.
Every night before bed, she makes it a routine to talk to Taiga on the phone.
She usually acts distant and aloof. Only when talking to Taiga over the phone—
when they can't see each other's faces—can she be just a little bit honest with her feelings.
Her favorite food is chocolate, as, even though she’s a cat,
she likes things that aren't bitter.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 144cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B75 / W55 / H79
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Chocolate
[i]Blood type[/i]: AB
[i]Birthday[/i]: February 22nd

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]
